slug: 2017-01-01 AU - Report on the Status of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in Africa
note: A continental report of the October 2016 APAI-CRVS monitoring round that names Côte d'Ivoire only in the annex's score bands: its composite digitisation score falls in the 35-49% band, one of three countries there. The composite mixes electronic recording, notification, transmission and the identity link, and the country's answer to the question on electronic capture at local offices is not published, so no aspect value can be taken; no system is named.
